scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/www && npm install --prefix apps/apply && npm install --prefix apps/board && (python3 -m venv backend/.venv || python -m venv backend/.venv) && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt --disable-pip-version-check --no-input
scripts.dev: concurrently -n www,apply,board,backend -c cyan,green,magenta,blue "npm --prefix apps/www run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173" "npm --prefix apps/apply run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173" "npm --prefix apps/board run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4174" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:www && npm run build:apply && npm run build:board
